scope: All 33 active scientific repositories placed in one layered world-state-access-domain-contact-field system. Series remain distinct ownership units.
system_surface: WORLD -> STATE -> ACCESS -> DOMAIN -> CONTACT -> FIELD -> UPDATE
system_rule: connection != ownership; developmental ancestry != conceptual hierarchy; empirical projection != validation; radius != importance

node_roles.hotarubukuro: focal Campanula flower-colour geography publication system
node_roles.chun: evolutionary-time and molecular flower-colour recurrence programme
node_roles.azami: present-day thistle image-phenomics and environmental structure
node_roles.EAzami: public-data evolutionary history and recurrence/depth discrimination
node_roles.aza3: own-data ancestry × phenotype × cytotype history discrimination
node_roles.izu-core: conditional island interaction-response geometry and empirical interface
node_roles.shimahotarubukuro: focal Izu Campanula floral phenotype divergence
node_roles.pollipi: physical flower-visitor primary-record system; target-facing observation application
node_roles.insepi: physical observer-system intervention diagnosis focused on nuisance/observability/shared-optical failure
node_roles.boundary: identification boundary induced by the current observation map
node_roles.mrod: active next-observation design for remaining compatible mechanism/world distinctions
node_roles.theouni: meta-theory, admission grammar and portfolio registry
node_roles.egwee: independent natural-data state/proxy adequacy interface; natural context does not validate warning
node_roles.sch: shared-coordinate functional conflict and compromise geometry
node_roles.bita: differentiated-coordinate architecture gain and mechanism-allocation boundary
node_roles.sdmr: environmental-coordinate admission and leakage-free SDM method; empirical promotion not supported
node_roles.odsp: multidimensional niche geometry and state-resolved prediction
node_roles.acsp: bounded candidate-patch survey prioritization; field interface, not occupancy or guaranteed detection

state_access_interface.required_state: CREST with CCOC/MLTR/MRM defines what distinctions must be retained for the scientific contract.
state_access_interface.observational_access: REC/V3/TNOA determine support/refinement/semantic structure; Boundary determines what is structurally identifiable; MROD chooses a future distinguishing observation.
state_access_interface.reportability: CED asks whether current evidence identifies enough of the required distinction to license the requested target/report.

within_series_state_transitions.surface: shared-coordinate compromise -> middle world -> differentiated architecture
environmental coordinate admission -> multidimensional state -> compatible/reachable worlds -> candidate survey patches
within_series_state_transitions.rule: epistemic sequence, not automatic evidence inheritance

within_series_state_transitions.surface: present phenotype -> public history -> own-data discrimination
WHEN/WHERE -> conditional response geometry -> focal phenotype

domain_interfaces.object: relational future-relevant state may condition the ecological context underlying L,s,K,phi,eta; no same-system validation yet
state idea -> natural-data adequacy gates; warning statistic is not externally validated
Honshu-Izu functional data used under a distinct state-adequacy question
WHAT to measure <-> WHERE to look

contact_to_field.object: candidate patch -> field verification / primary-data intake

284b.rule: not a fifth niche chapter until it declares an independent question and evidence contract

system_cycle: encounter a distinction or failure in a real biological/measurement system
formalize ecological worlds and determine which distinctions a scientific state must retain
audit what observation preserves, loses or cannot identify
find an executable natural-data, instrument or survey contact
return to field or primary data
use failure, non-identifiability, adverse transport and residual context to revise the representation without erasing provenance
non_edges: shared philosophy or TMOP membership alone is not a scientific edge
PolliPi/InsePi development ancestry does not make them conceptually upstream of TNOA/V3/REC
EGWEE natural examples do not externally validate the EGC/EGWE warning statistic
EGWE-to-PAYOFF is a proposed state-to-payoff interface, not a current empirical bridge
ACSP candidate patches do not imply occupancy or guaranteed detection
later empirical work does not retroactively validate an earlier bounded/failed gate
